author: Asursion
body:
• IGN: Asursion, alt MROCFTW (in case)
  • Banned by: MidnightBeats
  • Reason: "Hacking- Kill Aura"
  • Date: October 9th, 2015, 12:37:40 AM GMT.
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server:
    - I honestly never hacked, or did anything to seem like it, all I was doing was pvping, I love to pvp, and avicus is a good server to do so on. I have never been hackusated or banned for hacking before today on avicus.
    - I believe this was a mistake of some sort. It might have seemed as if I was hacking, but in reality, I was not. I was mostly pvping people, I am very good at pvp, in my own opinion, and I think this was plainly a visual mistake.
    - I know several people reported me.. did anyone even check me out?

If I am not unbanned for a little while, or never unbanned at all, I completely understand. :).

Thanks for reading my ban appeal,
    - Asursion :)
